svg.title: MOSIP Release History (illustrative example)
svg.text: Latest releases at the top. Platform releases are consolidation milestones.
Component releases are independent updates and can be applied to specific platform versions.
All platform versions from v1.2.0 onward are releases within the 1.2.x LTS
and do not start a new LTS support period.
Urgent fix for an older platform version
Automation fixes and expanded API test coverage.
Consolidated platform release with validated component versions.
Registration Processor performance and stability improvements.
Component releases between v1.2.1.0 and v1.2.1.1 (4 releases)
Consolidated platform release with validated component versions.
Migration from Java 11 to Java 21; repositories move to SemVer from v1.3.0.
Maintenance component releases for platform v1.2.0.x after v1.2.1.0 (6 releases)
26 Dec 2025 – Present · published after v1.2.1.0, applicable only to platform v1.2.0.x
Platform patch for v1.2.0.x with performance improvements and critical fixes.
Illustrative example based on published releases. Test libraries (API Test Commons), Rapid Deployment Infra and release
candidates are not shown. See the Releases page for the complete and current list.
